OakWelcomeKantoText:
OAK: Ah, !
It's good of you

to come all this
way to KANTO.

What do you think
of the trainers

out here?
Pretty tough, huh?
OakLabDexCheckText:
How is your #-
DEX coming?

Let's see…
OakLabGoodbyeText:
If you're in the
area, I hope you come visit again.
OakOpenMtSilverText:
OAK: Wow! That's
excellent!

You collected the
BADGES of GYMS in KANTO. Well done!

I was right in my
assessment of you.

Tell you what,
. I'll make

arrangements so
that you can go to MT.SILVER.

MT.SILVER is a big
mountain that is

home to many wild
#MON.

It's too dangerous
for your average

trainer, so it's
off limits. But

we can make an
exception in your case, .

Go up to INDIGO
PLATEAU. You can

reach MT.SILVER
from there.
OakNoKantoBadgesText:
OAK: Hmm? You're
not collecting KANTO GYM BADGES?

The GYM LEADERS in
KANTO are as tough

as any you battled
in JOHTO.

I recommend that
you challenge them.
OakYesKantoBadgesText:
OAK: Ah, you're
collecting KANTO GYM BADGES.

I imagine that
it's hard, but the

experience is sure
to help you.

Come see me when
you get them all.

I'll have a gift
for you.

Keep trying hard,
!
OaksAssistant1Text:
The PROF's #MON
TALK radio program

isn't aired here
in KANTO.

It's a shame--I'd
like to hear it.
OaksAssistant2Text:
Thanks to your
work on the #- DEX, the PROF's

research is coming
along great.
OaksAssistant3Text:
Don't tell anyone,
but PROF.OAK'S

#MON TALK isn't
a live broadcast.

OaksLabPoster2Text:

manner.
